name: Nasdaq

subjectOf.text: Self regulatory organizations occupy a distinctive position, holding some regulatory authority while remaining beholden to the SEC, which makes them the right actors to educate the SEC toward a more crypto friendly stance by demonstrating successful use cases.
subjectOf.abstract: SROs are also in a unique position to help educate the SEC to becoming more crypto friendly.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Samuel Evans, Blockchain-Based Securities Offerings (2019). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3411110
scope_conditions: SROs such as FINRA, Nasdaq, and NYSE that remain subject to SEC oversight

subjectOf.text: Bringing NASDAQ-listed stocks on-chain removes the need to mint intermediary virtual representations of off-chain equities, because tokenized stocks are natively verifiable on blockchain ledgers, which reduces legal and operational friction.
subjectOf.abstract: By bringing NASDAQ-listed stocks on-chain, the need to mint intermediary virtual representations of off-chain equities as an accounting measure is eliminated. NASDAQ tokenized stocks are natively verifiable on blockchain ledgers. This is key as it reduces legal and operational friction.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
scope_conditions: NASDAQ tokenized stock framework in operation

subjectOf.text: The NASDAQ tokenized stock framework materially expands the addressable market for LER, because every NASDAQ-listed stock becomes potentially eligible for time-weighted voucher reward accruals.
subjectOf.abstract: Second, it significantly increases the addressable market for LER because all of NASDAQ-listed stocks are now potentially eligible for LER's time-weighted voucher loyalty reward accruals.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
scope_conditions: conditional on SEC approval of the NASDAQ framework

subjectOf.text: Regulatory uncertainty, in particular the timeline for SEC approval of the NASDAQ and Dinari tokenization frameworks, could delay LER implementation.
subjectOf.abstract: Regulatory uncertainties, such as the timeline for SEC approval for NASDAQ and Dinari frameworks could delay LER implementation.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Liquid Equity Rewards (2025). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=5454054
scope_conditions: pending SEC approval of tokenized securities trading
